lines: Apni aawaz ki larzish pe to qabu pa lo
Pyaar ke bol to honthon se nikal jaate hain
couplets.en: Steady the tremor in your voice, for words of love have a way of slipping past the lips.

lines: Apne tevar to sambhalo ke koi ye na kahe
Dil badalte hain to chehre bhi badal jaate hain
couplets.en: Keep your composure, lest someone say that faces change when hearts do.

lines: Ye dil, ye paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this restless heart of mine gone dark, my wandering?

lines: Ye dil, ye paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this restless heart of mine gone dark, my wandering?

lines: Is dasht mein ek shahr tha, woh kya hua, aawargi?
Ye dil, ye paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Tell me, my wandering, what became of the city in this wilderness and why my restless heart went dark.

lines: Kal shab mujhe be-shakl ki aawaz ne chaunka diya
couplets.en: Last night the voice of a presence without form startled me.

lines: Maine kaha, tu kaun hai, usne kaha, aawargi
couplets.en: I asked who it was, and it told me it was wandering.

lines: Ye dil, ye paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this restless heart of mine gone dark, my wandering?

lines: Ik ajnabi jhonke ne jab poochha mere gham ka sabab
couplets.en: A passing gust asked what had brought me grief.

lines: Ik ajnabi jhonke ne jab poochha mere gham ka sabab
Sehra ki bheegi ret par maine likha, aawargi
couplets.en: When a passing gust asked the cause of my grief, I wrote wandering in the damp desert sand.

lines: Ye dil, ye paagal dil mera, kyun bujh gaya, aawargi?
couplets.en: Why has this restless heart of mine gone dark, my wandering?
